titleBox.en: Even Wellness Founders Struggle With Their Own Wellness

captions.en: Hi, I'm Soaming, founder of Soaming Lab.
I launched Soaming Lab in July and started a whole new chapter.
Yesterday, for the first time, I completely fell apart.
I started this because I love it, but I couldn't stop asking myself, "Is this right?"
On top of that, I felt impatient and lost.
If you've ever left a steady paycheck to start your own thing,
you've probably been through this too.
I had a steady paycheck too. Now that I'm carving my own path,
I can't shake the anxiety of just getting through each day.
Thankfully, people who believe in me keep opening doors,
and new opportunities keep coming my way.
But my vision and dreams are huge,
and while I'm building toward them, I keep asking how to get through each day.

captions.small: 오늘 하루도 내 마음을 지키는 게
captions.en: That's when it hit me: protecting my peace, one day at a time, really matters.

captions.big:
정작 제 웰니스는
못 챙기고 있었어요
captions.en: I run a wellness business, but I'd stopped taking care of my own wellness.

captions.small: 몇 달째 잠도 제대로 못 자고,
captions.en: I hadn't slept properly in months, and the stress had really taken a toll on my body.
If I can't take care of myself, how can I help anyone else?
I have to look after my own heart and wellness before I can pass it on.

captions.small: 그래서 일단 나부터 수면 패턴을 지키고
captions.big:
에너지를 끌어올려서
좋은 에너지를 줄 수 있도록
captions.en: So I'm starting with me: better sleep, more energy, so I can pour into others.
I realized I need to be a clear channel first.
It's been hard. Even though I truly love what I do,

captions.big:
이 길이 맞을까
계속 의문이 들고
captions.en: I keep asking myself if this is the right path.
I believe God brought me here,
but feeling like I have to prove myself every single day has been really painful.
